title: The Wagoner and Hercules

full_text:
A country wagoner was driving his heavy wagon of grain down a muddy country lane when the wheels sank up to the axles in deep mire. The horses strained, but could not budge the cart.

The lazy wagoner dropped his whip, fell to his knees in the mud, and began praying loudly to the heroic champion Hercules to come down from the clouds and lift his wagon.

A voice of thunder echoed from the heavens:

"Take up your whip, idle knave! Put your shoulder to the wheel and urge your team forward! How do you expect assistance when you refuse to lift a single finger to help yourself?"
moral: Heaven helps those who put their own shoulder to the wheel.
